subject: website
name: tieout
summary: tieout, a demo that rebuilds a wstETH position from public chain data and ties it to a ledger, open source (MIT) in nick-railsback/tieout. It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: its live position and anchor come from Ethereum and Base RPC endpoints, read without a light client.

connections.name: Ethereum RPC (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com)
connections.note: WebSocket subscription opened when the page loads.

connections.name: Base RPC (mainnet.base.org)
connections.note: Anchor read when the page loads.
